name: @hypaware/mastracode
description: Mastra Code client adapter for HypAware. Reads Mastra Code's own mastra.db read-only (LLP 0586) and materializes threads/messages into ai_gateway_messages via the shared ai_gateway.projected_exchange materializer: a backfill provider for history and a poll source for ongoing capture. No gateway proxying, no changes to Mastra Code.

config_sections.summary: Mastra Code adapter config: enabled, db_path (override), poll_interval.
